_note: Episode 43 (S5E2), story version 2 Kabanata 43. Present day at the river port of Butuan in the second week of the flood; Usman present. Indio in his forties (string of Episodes 48 and 49); in the anting armour from the roll call on. Totoy and Albo strings from Episode 46. The diwa of the datu are light only, no clear face, never a likeness. No readable text: the counter and the map have no letters or digits. Reused frames: shots 5, 8, 9, 11, 18, 21, 37, 45, 46, 53, 59 repeat the frame before them on purpose.
style: Style: modern Japanese TV anime key frame, crisp clean ink line art, cel shading with two-tone hard shadows, vivid saturated colour, expressive face.
white: Anime character illustration, medium shot from the waist up, the whole head and both shoulders visible with space above the head, character centered, on a plain flat solid bright green chroma-key background with nothing else:

full.boats_few: A river port at night in heavy rain, giant wooden plank ships of the old Butuan kind lined up with lanterns on their masts: wide shot of crowds still waiting on the shore in the rain, only a few ships left, worried faces lit by lanterns.
full.horn_blow: On the flat wooden roof of a giant wooden plank ark at night in heavy rain, river port lights below: low angle of a Filipino man in his forties with a black topknot with a few grey strands, a long dark grey coat, a red handkerchief on his wrist holding a smooth wooden shepherd's crook planted in the roof, blowing an old curved carabao horn trumpet toward the sky, rain swirling.
full.intro: A swirling golden time portal of clock gears and light opening over a rainy river port at night: a Filipino man in his forties with a black topknot with a few grey strands, a long dark grey coat, a red handkerchief on his wrist stepping toward the viewer beside a black street dog with a white chest patch and a red kerchief, warm confident smile. Medium wide shot.
full.port_wide: A river port at night in heavy rain, giant wooden plank ships of the old Butuan kind lined up with lanterns on their masts: epic wide shot from high above, dozens of giant ships in a row along the river, tiny people boarding by torchlight.
full.plank_close: Close-up of the side of a huge wooden boat hull: carved planks joined edge to edge with rows of wooden pegs and tight fibre lashings, rain running down, lantern light.
full.totoy_bow: A river port at night in heavy rain, giant wooden plank ships of the old Butuan kind lined up with lanterns on their masts: low angle of a Filipino man in his late twenties in a ship captain's cap and rain coat standing at the bow of the biggest ship, broad shoulders, grinning, one hand raised in a joking salute.
full.totoy_bread: A river port at night in heavy rain, giant wooden plank ships of the old Butuan kind lined up with lanterns on their masts: medium shot of a Filipino man in his late twenties in a ship captain's cap and rain coat laughing beside stacked sacks of bread in a wooden ship hold lit by lanterns.
full.sebyo_pier: A river port at night in rain: an old Filipino boatbuilder with white hair, a wide straw hat and a wet work shirt standing alone on a wooden pier, watching the last ship, refusing to leave. Medium shot.
full.world_sinking: A dark ocean at night in heavy rain: far away the lights of a distant coastal city of towers going under the water one by one, no people visible. Wide telephoto shot.
full.eyes_clouds: Dark rain clouds at night: countless tiny cold glowing eyes in the gaps between the clouds, waiting, no bodies visible.
full.horn_take: On the flat wooden roof of a giant wooden plank ark at night in heavy rain, river port lights below: close-up of hands taking an old curved carabao horn trumpet on a cord from a coat, rain on the horn.
full.lolo_memory: A memory with soft glowing edges: the dark mouth of a mountain cave, an old white-haired Filipino man in a faded polo shirt handing a curved carabao horn trumpet to a younger man, warm and sad.
full.crook_plant: On the flat wooden roof of a giant wooden plank ark at night in heavy rain, river port lights below: close-up of a smooth old wooden shepherd's crook driven into a wooden roof, a hand gripping it, rain streaming down.
full.sound_wave: Night over a dark river and sea in rain: a soft glowing ring of golden light spreading slowly outward from a ship across the water and up into the clouds. Wide high angle.
full.sound_portals: Night sky in rain: many round glowing golden doorways of light opening one after another across the clouds and over distant seas, the ring of sound passing through them.
full.medallions_wake: On the flat wooden roof of a giant wooden plank ark at night in heavy rain, river port lights below: close-up of a Filipino man in his forties with a black topknot with a few grey strands, ornate golden armour plates made of twelve round bronze medallions over a long dark grey coat, a red handkerchief on his wrist, the bronze medallions on his armour lighting up one by one with warm gold light.
full.diwa_rise: On the flat wooden roof of a giant wooden plank ark at night in heavy rain, river port lights below: twelve tall glowing figures of soft blue-gold light rising around the man in golden armour, translucent, no clear faces, each a different stance. Wide shot.
full.diwa_sulayman: Night rain at a river mouth: a tall translucent glowing figure of a young pre-colonial chieftain made of soft blue-gold light, no clear face, standing first, chest out, fists closed, fiery orange glow at his heart.
full.diwa_kiling: A river port at night in heavy rain, giant wooden plank ships of the old Butuan kind lined up with lanterns on their masts: a translucent glowing figure of an old pre-colonial chieftain made of soft blue-gold light, no clear face, standing on the pier with his head tilted, listening to the crowds.
full.diwa_lapulapu: Night rain on a beach: a translucent glowing figure of a pre-colonial warrior chieftain made of soft blue-gold light, no clear face, arms folded, silent and unmoving.
full.diwa_sikatuna: On the flat wooden roof of a giant wooden plank ark at night in heavy rain, river port lights below: a mysterious young Filipina woman with long black hair in a long dark coat holding a closed red umbrella, a round bronze medallion at her neck, her medallion glowing, a translucent glowing figure of a pre-colonial chieftain made of soft blue-gold light, no clear face, rising from it and turning toward a man like a brother.
full.twelve_awake: On the flat wooden roof of a giant wooden plank ark at night in heavy rain, river port lights below: a circle of twelve translucent glowing figures of soft blue-gold light around a Filipino man in his forties with a black topknot with a few grey strands, ornate golden armour plates made of twelve round bronze medallions over a long dark grey coat, a red handkerchief on his wrist, all facing outward, rain falling through them. High angle.
full.allies_come: Night over a river and sea in rain: shapes of many legendary creatures arriving from every direction, a giant bird, a tall horse-faced figure, a huge squid in the water, a hairy giant on the shore, all lit by lanterns. Epic wide shot.
full.yumud: Dark river water at night in rain: a calm glowing water spirit shaped like a flowing woman of light carrying a coughing child up to the surface toward a boat.
full.tikbalang_kapre: Night forest edge by a flooded river in rain: a tall thin dark creature of Philippine folklore with a long horse-like face and very long legs leading a line of lost people with lanterns, a huge hairy tree giant smoking a cigar watching from an old balete tree.
full.jack_roofs: Night over wet city rooftops in rain: a tall thin figure in a dark cloak with springs on his boots leaping high from roof to roof carrying a rope, a small green water creature with a dish on its head and a shadowy jaguar beside a boat.
full.kraken_pull: Dark ocean at night in rain: a colossal squid towing a line of small ships with its tentacles toward a row of giant lantern-lit wooden arks. Wide shot.
full.giants: A flooded shore at night in rain: a huge gentle giant, a white-furred yeti and several tall hairy forest giants carrying logs and people toward the arks. Wide shot.
full.all_here: A river port at night in heavy rain, giant wooden plank ships of the old Butuan kind lined up with lanterns on their masts: a vast crowd of legendary creatures gathered along the river by the arks, lanterns everywhere, calm and ready. Epic wide high angle.
full.barkada: A river port at night in heavy rain, giant wooden plank ships of the old Butuan kind lined up with lanterns on their masts: medium shot of a group of friends arriving on the pier in the rain: a woman with a waterproof camera, a stocky man in mechanic overalls, a middle-aged teacher with a notebook.
full.bea_camera: A river port at night in heavy rain, giant wooden plank ships of the old Butuan kind lined up with lanterns on their masts: close-up of a Filipina woman in her thirties with short hair in a rain jacket holding a waterproof camera, serious eyes, rain on the lens.
full.jm_truck: A flooded road by a river port at night: a stocky Filipino man in his thirties in grease-stained overalls driving a diesel tanker truck through shallow water, headlights in the rain.
full.pipay_stream: A dry corner inside a wooden ship at night: a young Filipina woman with a ponytail holding a phone up to stream, a glowing ring of golden sound on the phone screen, nothing readable.
full.pacing_boats: A dark sea at night in rain: a long line of small Filipino fishing boats with outriggers led by an old woman with a headscarf in the first boat, lanterns swinging.
full.camar_carve: A river port at night in heavy rain, giant wooden plank ships of the old Butuan kind lined up with lanterns on their masts: an old Maranao woodcarver carving a bright sarimanok bird figure with curling geometric line art on the bow of a giant wooden ark, wood shavings, lantern light.
full.adela_song: Inside a lantern-lit wooden ark at night: an older Indigenous Amazonian woman healer singing softly to a group of children lying on mats, calm faces.
full.albo_feather: Night sky over a river port in rain: a single white feather drifting down, and behind it a tall gentle figure of soft white light with long white hair and a calm kind face descending slowly from the clouds.
full.holo_counter: On the flat wooden roof of a giant wooden plank ark at night in heavy rain, river port lights below: close-up of a glowing blue-gold holographic panel with a small unnamed counter at its edge, digits blurred and unreadable, glowing brighter.
full.counter_spin: On the flat wooden roof of a giant wooden plank ark at night in heavy rain, river port lights below: extreme close-up of a holographic counter spinning fast, a blur of light, golden sparks, nothing readable.
full.rooftops_lights: Wet rooftops of a huge Filipino city at night in the rain: thousands of ordinary people standing on every roof holding up phone lights, torches, flashlights and candles toward the sky. Epic wide shot.
full.lights_close: Night in rain: close-up of many hands held up, phone lights, a candle, a torch, a flashlight, faces of different ages lit from below.
full.mountains_lights: Green mountains at night above a flood: tiny lights of thousands of people on every ridge, held up toward the sky. Wide telephoto shot.
full.ka_indio: Night rain over a city: a single child on a rooftop holding up a candle, looking at the sky with hope. Medium close-up.
full.usman_literal: On the flat wooden roof of a giant wooden plank ark at night in heavy rain, river port lights below: close-up of a medium-sized black Philippine street dog with a white chest patch, one folded ear and bright clever eyes, a red kerchief around his neck, eyes wide in wonder, then a crooked grin, lights reflected in his eyes.
full.m_rain: On the flat wooden roof of a giant wooden plank ark at night in heavy rain, river port lights below: medium shot of a mysterious young Filipina woman with long black hair in a long dark coat holding a closed red umbrella, a round bronze medallion at her neck standing alone in the rain behind them, calm.
full.m_fingers: On the flat wooden roof of a giant wooden plank ark at night in heavy rain, river port lights below: close-up of a mysterious young Filipina woman with long black hair in a long dark coat holding a closed red umbrella, a round bronze medallion at her neck raising one hand with five fingers spread, glowing faintly, rain around it.
full.key_grooves: Close-up of an old bronze key with five glowing notches along its blade, seen through a round brass lens, the notches turning into five glowing points on a faint map of islands.
full.map_five: A glowing map of the Philippine islands floating in the dark, five points of warm light: one on Manila Bay, one on Mactan, one on Bohol, one on Lake Lanao in Mindanao, one on Sulu. No text.
full.m_speaks: On the flat wooden roof of a giant wooden plank ark at night in heavy rain, river port lights below: close-up of a mysterious young Filipina woman with long black hair in a long dark coat holding a closed red umbrella, a round bronze medallion at her neck, rain on her face, speaking low and certain.
full.usman_explain: A cosy simple studio corner with a rain-streaked window: a medium-sized black Philippine street dog with a white chest patch, one folded ear and bright clever eyes, a red kerchief around his neck sitting up straight like a teacher, one paw raised.
full.butuan_boat_dig: Daylight archaeological dig in a dried riverbed in the Philippines: the long dark planks of an ancient wooden boat lying exposed in wet clay ground, workers gently brushing them. Wide shot.
full.lashing_diagram: Simple clean illustration on warm paper: cross-section of an ancient plank boat showing planks joined edge to edge with wooden pegs and lashings, no text, no labels.
full.barangay_village: Warm painted illustration of an ancient Philippine coastal village with stilt houses, a long plank boat pulled up on the beach, families beside it, morning light. No text.
full.song_court: Painted illustration of a large Chinese imperial palace hall of the Song era, a small group of foreign envoys from an island kingdom bowing with gifts, red pillars, seen from far away. No readable text.
full.tambuli_still: A carabao horn trumpet lying on a woven mat in a bamboo house, simple still life, warm light.
full.fiction_card: Night sea in rain: a long fleet of giant lantern-lit wooden plank ships with carved bird figures on their bows, many glowing creature shapes around them, a great serpent in the clouds. Wide shot.
full.five_lands: A dark sea at night: five pillars of warm light rising from five distant islands across the horizon, storm clouds above. Wide shot.
full.pasig_mouth: A wide river mouth meeting a stormy bay at night, old stone walls on one side, a tall wave rising far out at sea, the city behind. Wide shot, tense.
full.comment: On the flat wooden roof of a giant wooden plank ark at night in heavy rain, river port lights below: medium shot of a Filipino man in his forties with a black topknot with a few grey strands, a long dark grey coat, a red handkerchief on his wrist and a medium-sized black Philippine street dog with a white chest patch, one folded ear and bright clever eyes, a red kerchief around his neck facing the viewer, Indio holding up an old curved carabao horn, a small smile.
full.question: Night in rain: a young person on a rooftop holding up a phone light toward a sky full of tiny lights. Medium shot, hopeful.
full.follow: Night above the rain clouds: a Filipino man in his forties with a black topknot with a few grey strands, a long dark grey coat, a red handkerchief on his wrist and a medium-sized black Philippine street dog with a white chest patch, one folded ear and bright clever eyes, a red kerchief around his neck riding on the head of a colossal sea serpent of Philippine folklore with glittering silver-blue scales, a huge mouth and fins like wings, a fleet of lantern-lit arks far below. Epic wide shot.
